folds.method: outer StratifiedGroupKFold; within each outer-train, the other global folds are inner folds; pair-excluded probes are shared across the two valid nested directions

probes.objective: group-equal weighted BCE independently summed across branches
probes.initialization: four distinct seed-derived slots; every candidate layer in an eight-layer depth band matches the corresponding repeat-L32 slot
probes.matched_l32_convention: pool L32 is the canonical nuisance estimator; repeat slot 3 parameters and AdamW state are synchronized after every update, and stored repeat slot-3 logits are copied from the canonical pool L32 score while raw GPU forward discrepancy is recorded

stack.selection: minimum strict nested train outer-group-OOF calibrated BCE
stack.calibration_selection: one shared family selected on repeat32 strict nested train outer-group-OOF by group-equal BCE; within tolerance prefer fewer parameters

comparisons.topology: four separately parameterized D+1 probe branches per arm, one 4+1 stack, and one shared-family calibrator with 0/1/2 active parameters; the registered pool-L32/repeat-slot-3 nuisance estimator is common to both matched arms
comparisons.repeat_control: four separately parameterized branches all consume layer 32; slot 3 shares the exact canonical L32 nuisance estimate across arms
comparisons.selected_constraint: one layer from each registered eight-layer comparison slot
comparisons.search_pool: all candidate probes are trained in one vectorized tensor with separable losses and no gradient clipping; unused search branches are excluded from each arm's parameter count

limitations: The frozen E03 representation and existing split identities were already explored; this remains diagnostic.
Cross-fitting isolates group_id during base-probe prediction, but it does not provide an independent LoRA seed.
Layer and hyperparameter choice adapts to nested train outer-fold metrics, so the selected train OOF number is descriptive; the independent validation gate controls promotion.
Validation applies only the registered pass/fallback gate; the calibrated decision threshold is fixed at 0.5.
Secondary test comparisons are exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity.
